data.narrative: Student implemented PostgreSQL full-text search for the URL shortener. Added search endpoint that uses to_tsvector with GIN index for fast search across code, long_url, and tags. Included graceful fallback to ILIKE search when FTS is unavailable. Added proper pagination support and database migration for search_vector column with trigger-based updates.

dimension_scores.observation: Student chose DB-native PostgreSQL FTS over dedicated search engine for simplicity and operational ease
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented PostgreSQL to_tsvector with GIN index instead of external search engine

dimension_scores.observation: Student handled FTS query syntax correctly using plainto_tsquery for safe user input
dimension_scores.evidence: Used plainto_tsquery('english', :query) instead of raw to_tsquery to prevent syntax errors

dimension_scores.observation: Student used parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection in search
dimension_scores.evidence: SQL text queries use :query, :skip, :limit placeholders with parameter binding

dimension_scores.observation: Student added GIN index and trigger for maintainable full-text search performance
dimension_scores.evidence: Created migration with GIN index and database trigger for automatic search_vector updates

dimension_scores.observation: Student documented search fallback strategy and pagination clearly
dimension_scores.evidence: Code includes comments explaining FTS fallback to ILIKE and proper pagination handling

strengths: Proper use of PostgreSQL FTS with GIN index
Graceful fallback to simple ILIKE search
Database trigger for automatic index updates
data.recommendation: Consider adding search result ranking using ts_rank for relevance ordering
